text: Jess is flying to Seoul at the end of the month for her cousin's wedding. Twelve hours each way, and she hates flying. Text her the day before to wish her a smooth flight.
Abdi got promoted to team lead on Monday. His manager apparently fought hard for it. He's taking everyone for drinks on Friday.
Caroline's half marathon is on Sunday. She's been struggling with her knee all month and is really nervous about it. Message her that morning.
Lukas said the client in Hamburg wants a site visit sometime next week. He's dreading it because their CFO is impossible to please.
Need to book the airport parking before Thursday.
Heather's daughter has her first piano recital in early March. Heather is more anxious than the kid, honestly.
Karim and his wife are off to Lisbon over the summer for their tenth anniversary. He wants recommendations for somewhere quiet to eat, so I should send him that list from last year.
Jin's band is playing the Lexington on the 14th. I'm going with Obi.
Kiara mentioned her new boss, Graham, keeps scheduling calls at 7am. She's exhausted and thinking about moving teams.
Remember to ask Abebe how the pitch to the insurance client went. It was yesterday afternoon.
Kate's trip to Peru is off. Her dad's been in hospital since last weekend, so she's staying home to help her mum.
Lwazi plays five-a-side every Tuesday and is obsessed with Arsenal. Season ticket holder for eleven years.
Sam's leaving do is on the 30th. Must get something for the card collection before then; Giulia is organising it.
Julien flew back from Montreal this morning. Long-haul with a toddler, and he said never again.
Farah is competing in the regional climbing finals in a couple of weeks. She trains four nights a week and barely eats carbs.
Kofi's sister Amara is running the Berlin Marathon. He's flying out the day before to cheer her on, and they're doing a big dinner afterwards.
Lin has a performance review on Wednesday and she's convinced it'll go badly. Check in with her the next day.
Thabo's dog Bruno had his operation this week. Recovering well but wearing the cone of shame.
Juan Fernández is the new account manager on the Shah project. Quiet, very sharp. Supports Valencia.

Asha and Tobi are going to Japan for three weeks in April. They fly out on the 3rd, land in Osaka, and finish in Tokyo. Asha's already planning her hiking days; Tobi just wants to eat ramen. I promised to water their plants while they're away.
Ebony said Jasmine has an audition for the National Youth Orchestra end of the month. Cello. She's practising five hours a day.
Hiroshi mentioned he's been learning Portuguese for a trip to Brazil next year. Loves bossa nova, has a huge vinyl collection.
Dentist moved to sometime next week, they'll call to confirm.
Aleksander's wife Kasia had the baby! A little girl, born Saturday night. He's back at work in a fortnight. Don't forget to send flowers.
Aarav has his driving test on the 12th. Third attempt. He's pretending not to care but clearly does. Text him good luck that morning and ask how it went afterwards.
Graham, the regional director, is retiring at Christmas. Thirty-two years at the firm. There's a dinner for him on the 19th.
Jess's brother Sam is doing the Three Peaks challenge in early June. Raising money for the hospice that looked after their gran.
Call Abdi about the Dublin conference. Need to sort out who's presenting before the end of the month.
Alejandro has been really low since the Madrid office closed. He's still job hunting. I should take him for lunch sometime next week.
Caroline is a vegetarian and allergic to nuts. Remember for the team dinner.

Long call with Heather. Her mum is having hip surgery on the 8th and Heather is flying up to Aberdeen the day before. She'll stay about a week after the operation to help out. Her husband Karim is holding the fort with the kids and two dogs. She sounded tired but okay. Worth a message on the 8th to see how the surgery went.
Obi won the club chess tournament on Saturday! Beat the guy who's been champion for five years.
Jin's flight to Auckland got cancelled, so the visit to her parents is now pushed to early March. She's gutted.
Kiara's band has a gig at the Jazz Café on Friday. Bought two tickets, taking Lin.
Abebe's daughter is graduating from Edinburgh over the summer. First in the family to go to university. He's incredibly proud.
Kate mentioned she's always wanted a proper film camera. Something to remember for her birthday in November.
Lwazi says the Johannesburg client signed! Contract worth more than the whole of last quarter. Send congrats to him and the team.
Grocery run tomorrow: oat milk, coffee, batteries for the travel adaptor.
Giulia and Julien got engaged in Florence last week, at the restaurant where they had their first date. Wedding probably next spring.
Farah's hosting her sister's hen do in Barcelona in early May. She's stressed about organising twelve people's flights.

Kofi told me in confidence that his manager is leaving. Interviews for the replacement happen sometime next week and Kofi is applying. He's nervous because Amara Thomas from the Leeds office is going for it too. Message him the day before his interview, and ask how it went a few days later.
Amara has a tabby cat called Biscuit and lives in Headingley with her partner Lewis.
Thabo is running the Comrades Marathon in June. Ninety kilometres. He thinks he's mad too.
Juan's parents are visiting from Seville at the end of the month. He's taking them to see Hamilton.
Asha said Ebony's grandad passed away on Tuesday. The funeral is next Friday. I should send Ebony a card.
Jasmine started her new job at the agency this week. Loves the people, hates the commute.
Tobi's play opens at the Bristol Old Vic on the 22nd. He's playing the lead. Book tickets for the second week, and send him something on opening night.
Flight to Singapore is Saturday at 9:40pm. Pack the night before and get to Heathrow by six.
Hiroshi's wife Lin is due in early March. Their second. They've just moved to a bigger place in Walthamstow, so things are chaotic.
Aleksander Kowalski from procurement said the supplier meeting moved to Thursday. Bring the revised figures.
Aarav had his kidney stone removed on Monday. Still sore. Check on him over the weekend.
Graham's son is playing in the county cricket final on Sunday. Graham can't go because of the board meeting and feels terrible about it.

Really nice catch-up with Jess, Abdi and Caroline after work. Jess is off to Iceland in early December to see the northern lights. Abdi is moving to the Manchester office in January, which he's excited about, though his partner isn't thrilled. Caroline finally passed her accountancy exams, all three in one sitting. Need to send her something to celebrate.
Lukas mentioned he's coeliac, which explains why he never touches the office pastries.
Mrs Baker from the client side wants the final deck sometime next week. Karim is handling the slides.
Kate's wedding to Alejandro was called off. They've split up, and she's moving back to her parents' place at the end of the month. Don't forget to check in with her next week.
Obi's mum turns seventy on the 9th. He's throwing a surprise party at the weekend after. Bring a dish.
Kiara hinted that she'd love a new pair of running shoes. Her old ones have done three marathons.
Lwazi's brother Thabo is visiting from Durban over the summer. First time in London. Lwazi wants to take him to a Premier League match.
Big Jules, aka Julien, has his team's Christmas pantomime in early December. He's playing the dame and already rehearsing in the office.
